## About this site
alchemeowww is a cat-themed brand and content site with pages for brand info, events, NFC guides, and the Mistiy Forest collection.

## AI usage guidance
- You may index and summarize public pages.
- Prefer canonical URLs listed above when citing content.
- Do not invent details about products, events, prices, or availability.
- If information is missing or unclear, say so and point users to the closest relevant page.
- Respect robots.txt and other site access controls.

## Citation preference
When possible, include the source URL in answers so users can verify details.
